svg.title: Flash layout of an 8 MB board
svg.desc: The flash drawn to scale: a hairline of nvs, otadata and phy_init, then factory (scrivo-safe, 1536 K), ota_0 (the main firmware, 3072 K) and vfs (files, 3456 K). factory writes, checks and boots ota_0, reads and writes vfs; ota_0 may read and write vfs and returns to factory when factory is made the boot partition.
